author: GamingBolt
description: The Cosmic Abyss wraps an intricate puzzle game in the shell of a beautifully designed, if familiar, Lovecraftian atmospheric horror experience that strikes a delicate balance between allowing you to solve problems on your own and consistently propelling you forward.
title: Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
The long wait for Pragmata has finally ended, and it’s a stunner. But how much better of a stunner is it on the PS5 Pro when it’s pitted against the PS5 version? Does the Pro Enhanced label bring significant changes to Sony’s mid-gen machine, or is it just a layer of polish that you could do without? Well, we’re here to answer that and more, as we take a dive into how Pragmata’s visuals get jacked up on the Pro, while it manages to sustain consistent performance even in the nastiest of bouts against the robots you face.

If you’re thinking about joining Hugh and Diana on their adventure on the PS5 Pro, this one’s for you. And hey, you might just decide to finally get that upgrade if you watch this one after playing it on a base PS5. Either way, we’re happy to take you through a peek at how this one does on the PS5 Pro.
title: Pragmata PS5 Pro vs PS5 Graphics Comparison - A Worthy Upgrade?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Here we are yet again, not even a month since launch and Crimson Desert has officially sold more than five million copies. Is it a more significant milestone than four million, aside from “bigger number equals better”? 

Not exactly, though it would be naive to think that being such a major part of the conversation since its release wouldn't have attracted non-believers to give it a spin.
title: Crimson Desert Reaching 5 Million Proves That "Messy Greatness" Still Wins
